data.summary: Glaserei Beispielscheibe (a glazier) billed Johanna Beispielacker €396.27 for replacing the damaged pane in her living room window and for emergency glazing done on 10 November 2026. The invoice is dated 20 November 2026 and is due within 14 days of that date.
data.explanation: This is a service invoice, not an official letter with a legal deadline — the 14-day period is a payment term the glazier set. Pay the amount by the deadline shown to avoid a reminder (Mahnung) or late fees. Since this concerns repair work on your home, the labor portion (not materials) may be deductible as a "Handwerkerleistung" on your tax return — keep this invoice and pay by bank transfer (not cash) to qualify; a tax advisor can confirm the exact deductible share.
data.tax_note: Craftsman labor costs for repairs at your home (Handwerkerleistungen) can be deducted from your tax liability under §35a EStG; keep this invoice and proof of bank transfer payment as evidence.
